openings.claim: A removable carrier with independently withdrawable edge stops could constrain sideways travel without increasing the corner compression associated with rocking.
openings.delta: Refine the rim-clamp carrier: allocate four bolts to two strip-clamp pairs and two bolts to lateral stops. Straps retain separation; stops establish clearance. Clamp lands and anchors stay outside the marked opening. Release straps and remove the hatch completely; tether recoverable pieces. Drill or cut only strips. Independent stop withdrawal, rim access, overlap, bolt dimensions and strap reach remain unestablished.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: strap friction alone supplies restraint. At identical marked strap settings, engaged stops predict less travel than withdrawn stops; the rival predicts similar travel. The right-side card must leave sufficient overlap. Comparable sliding, clamp migration, rocking that loses overlap, or damage defeats the proposed operation. Marked strap length does not guarantee equal preload, limiting causal attribution.
openings.probe: First measure clamp lands, underside access, strap routing, bolt reach, stop clearance and overlap with the right-side card. Require stop withdrawal without changing clamp attachment or strap routing. If these checks fail, park the design; a trial cap does not establish feasibility. If feasible within ninety fabrication minutes, use two configurations and twelve total closure/pull trials within twenty observation minutes: one disturbed diagnostic closure with stops withdrawn and one with stops engaged at the same strap marks, followed by ten numbered opening cycles with stops engaged. Apply the right-side card again on the final closure. Use the supplied scale for 20 N; record position, migration, lift, reopening time and seal tears. Require position within 1 mm after ten cycles, resistance to the pull, reopening within thirty seconds, an unobstructed open aperture, no permanent deformation and no new seal tears. This is a probe, with no measured result or deployment claim.
assumptions: Existing rim geometry accepts reversible clamps and independent stops.
Supplied component dimensions and load capacities suffice; these indispensable resources are unknown.

assessment: One uncertain candidate. The altered diagnostic strengthens rival discrimination only if independent withdrawal and comparable strap preload are feasible. Every outcome requirement remains mandatory under disturbance except seal contact continuity.

lineage.reason: Replace slackening straps with independently withdrawn stops to target the lateral-restraint dependency; preserve feasibility and constraint limits.
